svg.title: Fix one rule, meet the next
svg.text: Fix one rule, meet the next
Day 10's names rule, judged by answers on 76 new questions.
A SENTENCE'S FIRST WORD, READ AS A NAME
“It's my first day. Where do I pick up my laptop?”
Day 06's rule: no source mentions “Where” → refused
Day 10's rule: “Collect your laptop and security badge…”
the new wrong answers are the reader's: the old rule hid them
by the smallest margin: counting the near tie, +0
if wrong costs 1: +6 · if it costs 3: -2
a decision needs a cost for wrong answers, stated first
